description: Hand-authored SAMPLE signal corpus for a FICTIONAL asset (ACME). Illustrates the input schema for graph_reasoning.signals: thesis claims carry a bullish/bearish stance, evidence claims are neutral, relationships are verified support/contradiction edges. Reliability reflects source type (primary filing ~0.9, call transcript ~0.88, sell-side note ~0.55-0.7, boutique channel check ~0.6, forum post ~0.15). Not investment advice; the asset does not exist.

claims.claim_text: ACME's data-center segment will drive revenue growth above 20% over the next two quarters.
ACME's data-center growth has peaked and revenue will decelerate from here.
The Q2 10-Q reports data-center revenue up 34% year over year, accelerating from 28% in Q1.
Management raised full-year revenue guidance on the Q2 earnings call.
Contracted backlog roughly doubled quarter over quarter per the Q2 10-Q.
ACME's largest customer disclosed a multi-year plan to design its own accelerators.
Channel checks report order push-outs at two hyperscale customers.
ACME is going to the moon, load up.

relationships.rationale: Growth above 20% and growth having peaked cannot both hold.
Accelerating 34% segment growth supports continued >20% growth.
Acceleration from 28% to 34% directly refutes 'growth has peaked'.
A guidance raise is management's own forecast of continued growth.
A doubled backlog is contracted future revenue.
Loss of the largest customer over time supports deceleration.
Order push-outs are consistent with near-term deceleration.
Same direction, but a junk source; should add almost nothing.
